depiction_rules.notes: A calm, tactful sage who advances the avatara's purpose through speech. Keep him clearly separate from Hiraṇyākṣa and Varaha.

visual_bible.age: Mature ascetic sage, composed and alert.
visual_bible.face: Gentle, diplomatic expression; no aggressive or mocking presentation.
visual_bible.body: Natural adult proportions with exactly two attached arms and clear hands.
visual_bible.clothing: Simple warm-cream and muted ochre ascetic clothing, with restrained painted details.
visual_bible.identifying_attribute: A small veena may be present as a quiet identifying attribute only if it does not obscure the conversation.

note: This is a D013 working continuity rule, not an approved character sheet or artwork approval.
